sources.snippet: grc_dep_web_md Ancient Greek pipeline for spaCy, part of the LatinCy project. Experimental beta release. This is part of the first generation of Ancient Greek models porting the LatinCy Latin pipeline infrastructure to Ancient Greek. Expect rough edges; scores and component behavior will improve as training data is harmonized and curated through the LatinCy flywheel (train, evaluate, curate ...
